name: Amaranthine Shield
body:
Aura: strong necromancy; CL 9h; Slot: shield; Price: +14,000 gp; Weight: as a masterwork shield of the appropriate type.

DESCRIPTION

One time per day, when the bearer of an amaranthine shield is affected by death spells, magical death effects, energy drain, and any negative energy effects, the shield instantly protects him as if he were under the effect of a death ward spell.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells death ward; Cost: +7,000 gp.
